articles.title: TikTok's $400 Million Privacy Penalty: What It Means for Kids Online
articles.summary: TikTok will pay a massive $400 million to settle a lawsuit over illegally collecting children's data. The Justice Department called it a victory for families. This comes as social media giants face growing legal pressure over youth privacy.

articles.title: Trade War Heats Up: Canada Vows Dollar-for-Dollar Tariffs on U.S.
articles.summary: After trade talks collapsed, Canadian PM Mark Carney called Trump's new tariffs a 'miscalculation' and promised matching levies starting September 8. Both sides blame each other for the breakdown, leaving the USMCA in jeopardy.

articles.title: South Korea Tests Arctic Shipping Route as Ice Melts and Middle East Conflict Disrupts Trade
articles.summary: The PanStar Acro is making South Korea's first commercial Arctic voyage, a route that could cut Asia-Europe shipping by 7,000 km. But environmentalists warn it accelerates ice melt, and Western allies worry about ties with Russia.
